Applying the quotient rule and using the formula for the derivative of $\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x,$  we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x}{{e}^{x}}) & =\frac{{e}^{x}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x)-\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({e}^{x})}{{({e}^{x})}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{x}\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}-\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x\cdot {e}^{x}}{{e}^{2x}} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}-\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x)}{{e}^{x}} \\  & =\frac{1}{{e}^{x}\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}-\frac{\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x}{{e}^{x}}.\end{aligned}
$$
